title: Shared-private multimodal fusion of near-infrared diffuse-reflectance and UV-Vis chromogenic spectra for geographical authentication of Meconopsis integrifolia

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Shared-private multimodal fusion of near-infrared diffuse-reflectance and UV-Vis chromogenic spectra for geographical authentication of Meconopsis integrifolia》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Geographical authentication of Meconopsis integrifolia is important for the quality control and sustainable utilization of plateau medicinal plant resources, but adjacent origins often exhibit highly similar spectral and chemical profiles.

evidence.text: Geographical authentication of Meconopsis integrifolia is important for the quality control and sustainable utilization of plateau medicinal plant resources, but adjacent origins often exhibit highly similar spectral and chemical profiles.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Shared-private multimodal fusion of near-infrared diffuse-reflectance and UV-Vis chromogenic spectra for geographical authentication of Meconopsis integrifolia》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】After spectral quality control and Isolation Forest outlier removal, sixteen preprocessing strategies combined with four classifiers were evaluated on the training set to determine the optimal NIR and UV-Vis modelling pipelines, which were then fixed for subsequent fusion experiments.

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】Internal five-fold cross-validation on the training set was used for model selection and stability evaluation, while an independent test set was reserved for final assessment.

evidence.text: After spectral quality control and Isolation Forest outlier removal, sixteen preprocessing strategies combined with four classifiers were evaluated on the training set to determine the optimal NIR and UV-Vis modelling pipelines, which were then fixed for subsequent fusion experiments.
Internal five-fold cross-validation on the training set was used for model selection and stability evaluation, while an independent test set was reserved for final assessment.

evidence.text: On the independent test set, SPMF correctly classified 40 of 41 samples, corresponding to an accuracy of 97.6%, with a 95% Wilson confidence interval of 87.4-99.6%.
The training-set five-fold cross-validation accuracy was 0.981 ± 0.004.
